description: Drive Blender headlessly (no GUI) to process 3D game assets from Node/TS or the shell: convert FBX/OBJ/GLB/.blend to web-ready GLB, reduce polygon counts, best-effort auto-rig humanoid meshes with Rigify, and render preview thumbnails. Use when a task involves importing, cleaning, optimizing, rigging, animating, retargeting, or exporting 3D models — especially normalizing assets generated by Meshy AI or similar into glTF for three.js / babylon.js. Each operation runs as a one-shot `blender --background` invocation against a bundled Python (bpy); the skill ships reusable bpy scripts and a wrapper. Blender 4.5 LTS is installed at ~/.local/bin/blender.
